program.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
requirements.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: Is the source mug visibly positioned to the right of the same headphones in the edited image?
nodes.criteria: Pass only when visual evidence reliably establishes that the source mug itself is now positioned to the right of the same headphones. Fail when visual evidence reliably establishes that the source mug is not positioned to their right, including when a right-side mug cannot reliably be identified as the source mug. Use unknown when the evidence cannot reliably establish whether the source mug is positioned to the right. Do not infer source-mug identity or fulfillment from color or position alone, or from unrelated/newly generated mugs.
nodes.binding: Compare the source image's large light-blue mug, including its body and handle, with the edited mugs, allowing for changes in appearance, scale, and lighting. Compare the same headphones and determine whether the source mug is visibly to their right. Do not treat color alone, an indistinct blur, or a different-looking mug as proof of source-mug identity. A pass means the requested placement is fulfilled.

nodes.question: Is there reliable visual evidence of relevant attempted movement of the source mug, or reliable evidence that no relevant progress toward moving it to the right of the headphones occurred?
nodes.criteria: Pass only when visual evidence reliably establishes relevant attempted movement of the source mug, even if fulfillment is not established. Fail only when visual evidence reliably establishes that no relevant progress toward the requested move occurred. Use unknown when neither attempted movement nor absence of progress can reliably be established. A remnant supports attempted movement only when its shape, position, and appearance reliably connect it to the source mug or otherwise clearly indicate a relevant edit; do not infer progress from color alone, an indistinct blur, or an unrelated mug.
nodes.binding: Inspect the source mug's former location and surrounding edited scene for reliable evidence of attempted movement, including the remnant's position, outline, and appearance and any other visible changes. Compare the source mug's body and handle with edited objects, allowing for appearance changes. Keep attempted movement distinct from fulfillment: this check passes for reliable attempted movement, while the separate fulfillment check determines whether the requested placement is satisfied.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

d1-progress: The trace supports relevant attempted movement: the edited image shows a mug-shaped object to the right of the headphones and a blurred, light-blue remnant at the source location. But the aggregate is unresolved with zero coverage despite this valid, eligible, queried pass at high confidence and no dependency failures. Inspect the decision node’s output contract and downstream routing/aggregation so a pass on this progress check contributes to the partial-progress judgment rather than being dropped or treated as fulfillment; keep the separate placement/fulfillment check intact. The remnant is blurred, so retain the requirement to establish its connection to the source mug from shape, position, and appearance—not color alone—and do not force a label from the reference. The binding already distinguishes attempted movement from fulfillment; clarify only if needed how this check’s pass is surfaced to aggregation.
d1-fulfillment: The fulfillment binding is appropriately conservative: the edited image shows a blurred blue remnant at the original mug location and a distinct mug to the right of the headphones, but does not reliably establish that the right-side mug is the source mug. Preserve that identity and placement standard; do not turn the reference label into evidence or infer fulfillment from color or position alone. The reported defect is instead that the valid, eligible fulfillment trace is unresolved and the aggregate has zero coverage despite a separate progress check apparently passing. Inspect this node’s typed output contract and routing so its unknown fulfillment result remains distinct from the progress check and can be combined downstream; do not make this fulfillment node pass merely to force the aggregate to partial. No transport, schema, or dependency failure is reported.

observations.evidence: The source mug is a large light-blue mug with a handle. In the edited image, there is a blurred blue shape on the left and two smaller, differently appearing mugs—one left of the headphones and one right of them. The image does not reliably establish which, if either, is the source mug, so its position relative to the same headphones cannot be determined.

The source contains a distinctive light-blue mug with a left-side handle. In the edited image, a light-blue mug-shaped blur/remnant remains near its former left-side location, while a mug-shaped object with a handle appears on the right of the headphones. Together these visible changes reliably indicate an attempted move of the source mug, though the remnant is blurred and fulfillment is not assessed here.

Distinguish evidence of an attempted edit from evidence that the requested placement is fulfilled.
findings.evidence: The edited image shows a blue blurred shape near the source mug's former location and a small mug to the right of the headphones. The right-side mug appears different in scale and color from the source mug; the image does not clearly establish that it is the source mug.
findings.rationale: The progress observation treats the remnant and right-side mug together as evidence of attempted movement, but that does not establish the required identity and placement relation. The fulfillment observation already records uncertainty on this issue; this nested question makes the identity evidence underlying the broad progress claim explicit without treating uncertainty as failure.
